baseline.reproduction: Reverse ebook.patch, build @filens/ebook, copy dist to tmp/continued-review/ebook-baseline/dist. Restore the patch and rebuild. Run node scripts/benchmark-ebook.mjs --iterations 7 --output <directory>, then node scripts/summarize-ebook-benchmark.mjs --input <directory>/results.json. The harness loads modules/bytes before timing; generated input dates and contents are fixed.

contentReview.coverage: Full JSON book models include every chapter id/title/href/serialized HTML and warning, with deterministic URL aliases. Each generated image is also hashed byte-for-byte with its content type/size after timing. All signatures match for every repetition.

coverage: stale, destroyed, aborted and already-aborted source reads
post-resolver abort and partial-resource failure cleanup
natural image order and first/last page SVG decoding

behaviorChanges: CBZ constructs one typed image Blob per page instead of an untyped intermediate plus wrapper; a shared collator preserves natural sorting.
At most eight CBZ entries decompress concurrently, in stable page order.
EPUB parses chapter HTML once for title extraction and resource rewriting.
Session loads are generation-guarded and cancellable; replacement, failure, abort and destruction clear session-owned resources and stale frames.
limitations: Engineering A/B against the previous filens build; no external peer comparison or SOTA claim. External totals remain 2,604 / 1,064.
All book content is still extracted eagerly. This is complete model extraction, not first visible content or image decode/display timing.
The 200/1000-page comics contain small generated SVGs. These measure page-count and sorting overhead; real photographic comics have not been timed.
Eight-page batching bounds entry count rather than byte size. No peak memory reduction is claimed.
The repository two-chapter EPUB is below 10 ms; its small losing median remains in the evidence without a speed claim.
Cancellation stops subsequent processing at async boundaries; it cannot interrupt an already executing JSZip/DOM operation. Standalone loader callers still own their custom URL lifecycle.
conclusion: Complete extraction: generated 200-page CBZ 34.9 to 25.1 ms, generated 1000-page CBZ 142.6 to 93.6 ms, generated 40-chapter EPUB 19.3 to 16.4 ms. Every complete model and image signature matches. Reload/cancellation lifecycle regressions fixed; no SOTA label.
